name: mx-social-contributions
description: Mexico social contributions (IMSS) reference for 2026. Covers employer and worker quotas under the Ley del Seguro Social (Arts. 28, 38, 39, 73, 147, 168, 211), the five occupational-risk classes, the SBC base and its 25x minimum-wage ceiling, INFONAVIT 5%, the retirement branch, state payroll taxes, monthly cedula payment by the 17th, and PTU. Trigger on Mexico IMSS, cuotas obrero patronales, salario base de cotizacion, INFONAVIT, PTU, prima de riesgo. Source-cited draft.
